sentences.text:
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3494 of 2020
Order:

This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 by the petitioners,
who are accused Nos.1 and 2, in C.C. No.157 of 2019 on the file of the Court of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Udayagiri, Nellore District.

entities.text: Court of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Udayagiri, Nellore District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offences alleged are under sections 273 and 353 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent.
3. Both the counsel submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018 and batch.
4.

In view of the above and in terms of the afore said order, this Criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in C.C. No.157 of 2019 on the file of the Court of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Udayagiri, Nellore District are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Court of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Udayagiri, Nellore District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
5. The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018, dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

JUSTICE D.RAMESH Date: 31.08.2020 YS Amara Nagaraja vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 31 August, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61876985/
